name: Unplug
author: Mulberry Tech

sections.description:
Unplug – Plugin Usage & Performance Insights

Cut the plugin bloat.

Unplug helps you see which plugins are actually being used on your client’s sites and which ones are just plugin bloat. With clear reports on plugin activity, performance impact, and where they are being used, you can make smarter decisions about what to keep, update, or remove.

🔑 Features

  • Plugin Usage Detection: Instantly see which plugins are actively used across your site.
  • Performance Insights: Identify plugins that may be slowing down your site.
  • Security Awareness: Get visibility into plugins that might increase risk.
  • Simple Recommendations: Understand at a glance which plugins to keep, replace, or unplug.

🚀 Why Use Unplug?

  • Improve site speed by removing unused plugins.
  • Reduce security risks by minimizing unnecessary code.
  • Keep your WordPress installation clean and efficient.
  • Save time by cutting through plugin overload.

Perfect For

  • Agencies managing multiple client sites.
  • Site owners who want faster, safer WordPress installs.
  • Developers looking for a quick audit of plugin usage.

⸻

Take control of your WordPress site today: it’s time to Unplug.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/unplug directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the Unplug menu in the WordPress admin to access plugin features.
